title: FlexiClip: Locality-Preserving Free-Form Character Animation
summary: Major: invalid Eq16-to-score reasoning underlying the central flow loss, invalid Appendix C diffusion derivation explicitly used to justify the pfODE component, and a disabled central score objective in the pinned release. Minor: nonzero initialization discrepancy. Historical experiment correspondence remains Needs Evidence; published performance is not reproduced or refuted.
limitations: No author code executed or experiments rerun.
Separate OpenReview supplement availability unresolved in preparation (403).

problems.title: Denoising risk incorrectly identified with score
problems.claim: Eq16 is essentially score function and motivates Eq17.
problems.location: PDF/printed p6 Eq16 and following paragraphs, Eqs17-19
assumptions: Smooth positive Gaussian densities and scalar covariance
problems.check: Exact risk =1/(1+c), noisy score=-y/(1+c); at c=1,y=0 these are .5 and 0.
problems.counterevidence: Heuristic score loss and joint SDS may still be useful; no empirical ranking refuted.
problems.impact: Invalid mathematical rationale explicitly used for named central flow objective.

correction.statement: D(y)-y=c grad log p_Y(y) for Gaussian Bayes denoiser under differentiation/integrability conditions.
correction.limits: Does not establish dimension preservation or detailed balance.

recovery_verification.check: Checked the c>0 Gaussian Bayes-denoiser counterexample and the Eq16-to-17-to-18 core-flow dependency. The scalar risk is 1/(1+c), while the noisy score is -y/(1+c); the residual identity and heuristic/empirical limits are retained.

assumptions: C(t)=t>0, Cdot=1, f=0, G=1 spatially homogeneous
